camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainTrafficData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2015-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2015-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries network traffic for one or more accelerated domain names. You can query data that is collected in the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainTrafficData查询加速域名的网络流量监控数据，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-traffic-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2015-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2015-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainTrafficData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

By default, this operation queries the network traffic for all accelerated domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。

默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data entries. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query ISPs.

If you do not specify an ISP, data of all ISPs is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名，通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~)获得。

默认查询所有运营商数据
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query regions.

If you do not specify a region, data in all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名，通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp~~)获得。

默认查询所有地域数据
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries returned. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried
